# The standard root paths of the configuration files of atom tools, which
# forbid-tool-configs forbids (ADR-0005): one path per line, below the root,
# grouped by the atom that owns the tool. Every released atom adds its own.

# atom-workflows: actionlint
.github/actionlint.yaml
.github/actionlint.yml
# atom-workflows: zizmor
.github/zizmor.yml
.github/zizmor.yaml
zizmor.yml
zizmor.yaml
# atom-nix: statix
statix.toml
# atom-shell: shellcheck, which also reads the name without the dot
.shellcheckrc
shellcheckrc
# atom-markdown: prettier, also the JavaScript and TypeScript forms that the
# atom refuses, and its ignore file, a configuration too (FY-0037)
.prettierrc
.prettierrc.json
.prettierrc.json5
.prettierrc.yaml
.prettierrc.yml
.prettierrc.toml
.prettierrc.js
.prettierrc.cjs
.prettierrc.mjs
.prettierrc.ts
.prettierrc.cts
.prettierrc.mts
prettier.config.js
prettier.config.cjs
prettier.config.mjs
prettier.config.ts
prettier.config.cts
prettier.config.mts
.prettierignore
# atom-markdown: markdownlint, and its ignore file
.markdownlint.json
.markdownlint.jsonc
.markdownlint.yaml
.markdownlint.yml
.markdownlintrc
.markdownlintignore
# atom-markdown: lychee, and its ignore file
lychee.toml
.lycheeignore
# atom-text: typos
typos.toml
_typos.toml
.typos.toml
# atom-text: editorconfig-checker, also the old name that the atom refuses
.editorconfig-checker.json
.ecrc
